source.origin: Advantage.Bid-led creative produced by the Owner and his creative collaborator after Phase 3P.1 (image-model assisted); Owner-approved by folder placement
source.rights: Advantage.Bid-owned reference creative. Calibration evidence only: the composition teaches attributes; the logo drawn inside it is an image-model rendering and is NOT an approved logo asset (production composites brand-assets/logos); merchandise is representative, not lots; every fact and claim visible is reference-only text unless separately approved. A representative person is depicted (image-model rendered); never a real customer or a testimonial.
source.campaign_title_visible: Sell With Confidence — Turn Your Items Into Opportunity

classification.event_product_type: Generic seller acquisition with a representative seller portrait (landscape 6:5)

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Logo lockup top-left → 'SELL WITH CONFIDENCE' (navy/blue uppercase, very large) → support line in spaced caps → three blue icon rows → blue CTA 'START SELLING TODAY →' → 'GET THE ADVANTAGE' rule. Right: a blue diagonal panel top-right with 'TURN YOUR ITEMS INTO OPPORTUNITY' and 'Simple. Secure. Successful.'; a smiling man in an apron at a laptop (the laptop shows the logo) behind a table of objects.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: Globe, vintage camera on a box, gilt-pattern vase, framed landscape, bronze horse, lamp, a cardboard box lettered 'Another Happy Seller!' — on a workbench in a shop/warehouse; a person is the visual centre.
visual_read.composition_style: Left copy column; portrait subject right of centre; objects along the bottom; a diagonal blue panel in the top-right corner; no navy band.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Uppercase condensed display; spaced-caps support; blue as the accent throughout.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Logo lockup large top-left; logo repeated on the laptop; 'GET THE ADVANTAGE' under the CTA.
visual_read.photographic_style: Image-model rendered editorial portrait with props; warm shop light.
visual_read.environmental_staged_composition: A working seller's bench; person as anchor; objects supported on the bench and boxes.

strongest_attributes: Approachable, human, aspirational — the seller as the hero, not the software
Confident headline; the objects are believable working-bench props
The Owner accepted a representative person in generic acquisition creative (this is new evidence; 3P.1's 'no fabricated people' was a safeguard I wrote, not an Owner rule)
transferable_lessons: A representative person may appear in GENERIC acquisition/brand creative when disclosed as representative and never presented as a specific customer or a testimonial
Landscape 6:5 acquisition layout with no band is acceptable when the logo is large and the CTA is unmistakable
Blue panels as a corner device are acceptable in blue-accent treatments
do_not_generalize: 'Another Happy Seller!' on the box — implies a testimonial; reference-only, never approved copy
'Reach thousands of serious bidders', 'Get top dollar', 'Low Seller Fees' — claims requiring production truth (marketing-package rules forbid promising outcomes)
The image-model logo on the laptop and in the header
The person's likeness — never reused; each generation is a new representative person; never in event creative
Blue-only palette without red — acceptable here, not the default

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: Headline dominance plus a corner panel; the rest is subordinate.
text_density_assessment.advantage_bid_budget_note: ACQUISITION_RICH ceiling; the corner panel counts as a block.

composition_assessment.spatial_logic: Bench scene with a person; props supported on the bench and a box.
composition_assessment.depth: Person mid, objects foreground, shelving background.
composition_assessment.scale_strategy: Person as scale reference; objects at true scale.
composition_assessment.edge_handling: Lamp and painting exit the right edge.

use_cases: seller acquisition with a representative person
avoid_for: any event creative (representative person never near real event facts)

provenance.analysis_method: Direct visual inspection at full resolution; pixel statistics computed from the file; est_* are visual estimates; text transcribed from the image and classified.
